audience: Tutoring institutes that run classes, students and parents in Wise

useCases.title: Find students without a class
useCases.text: List the students of the institute, filtered by class, status or tag, one page at a time.

useCases.title: Look up a teacher or student profile
useCases.text: List teachers with their tags and class counts, then read one participant's profile, status and tags by id.

useCases.title: Review linked parents
useCases.text: List parents, newest first, or read one parent with the students linked to them. Some namespaces do not offer parents.

useCases.title: Check institute report download links
useCases.text: List the reports generated for the institute, then check one report's status and its download link when it is ready.

useCases.title: Check the account and institute details
useCases.text: Read the Wise account behind the key, the institute's name and code, and its teaching locations.
